008package paint.shared.objects;
009
010import java.util.ArrayList;
011import java.util.List;
012
013/**
014 * Represents a scientific or research experiment containing
015 * a name and a collection of {@link Recording} instances.
016 *
017 * <p>Provides constructors for initialization and utility methods
018 * for managing the set of associated recordings.</p>
019 */
020public class Experiment {
021
022    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
023    // FIELDS
024    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
025
026    /**
027     * The name identifying this experiment.
028     */
029    private final String experimentName;
030
031    /**
032     * The collection of recordings associated with this experiment.
033     */
034    private final ArrayList<Recording> recordings;
035
036    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
037    // CONSTRUCTORS
038    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
039
040    /**
041     * Constructs an {@code Experiment} with a specified name.
042     *
043     * @param experimentName the name of the experiment
044     */
045    public Experiment(String experimentName) {
046        this.experimentName = experimentName;
047        this.recordings     = new ArrayList<>();
048    }
049
050    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
051    // ACCESSORS & MUTATORS
052    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
053
054    /**
055     * @return the name of this experiment.
056     */
057    public String getExperimentName() {
058        return experimentName;
059    }
060
061    /**
062     * Adds a recording to this experiment.
063     *
064     * @param recording the {@link Recording} to add
065     */
066    public void   addRecording(Recording recording) {
067        this.recordings.add(recording);
068    }
069
070    /**
071     * @return the list of {@link Recording} objects in this experiment.
072     */
073    public List<Recording> getRecordings() {
074        return recordings;
075    }
076
077    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
078    // STRING REPRESENTATION
079    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
080
081    /**
082     * Returns a formatted string summary of the experiment and its recordings.
083     *
084     * @return formatted string representation of the experiment
085     */
086    @Override
087    public String toString() {
088        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
089        sb.append("\n\n");
090        sb.append("----------------------------------------------------------------------\n");
091        sb.append("Experiment: ").append(experimentName).append("\n");
092        sb.append("----------------------------------------------------------------------\n");
093        sb.append("\n");
094        sb.append(String.format("%nExperiment %s has %d recordings%n", experimentName, recordings.size()));
095        for (Recording recording : recordings) {
096            sb.append(String.format("\t%s%n", recording.getRecordingName()));
097        }
098        return sb.toString();
099    }
100}
